lang.list: [Draft] Languages: {0}. Type /lang and a code, for example /lang en.
lobby.leader_hint: [Draft] You are the lobby leader: type /draft when everyone has a hero (or /chaos for random heroes and abilities).
lobby.player_hint: [Draft] Pick a hero and wait for the lobby leader to start the draft.
lobby.steam_unavailable: [Draft] Steam connect is not available, use connect <ip>:27067
lobby.new_leader: [Draft] You are the lobby leader now.
lobby.hero_taken: [Draft] That hero is already taken - pick another one.
draft.no_hero: [Draft] No hero picked, you sit this draft out.
draft.your_kit_waiting: [Draft] Your kit: {0}. Waiting for the other players.
draft.no_rerolls: No rerolls left for this pick.
draft.taken_free_reroll: [Draft] {0} is already taken - here are new cards, this reroll is free.
draft.taken_replaced: [Draft] {0} was just taken - your cards were replaced for free.
draft.screen_click: Click a card or type 1, 2 or 3 in chat
draft.screen_click_chat: [Draft] Ability draft: click a card or type 1, 2 or 3 in chat. Blank cards? Type /vpk off.
draft.screen_type: Type 1, 2 or 3 in chat - clicking a card does nothing
draft.screen_type_chat: [Draft] Ability draft: type 1, 2 or 3 in chat (left, top, right). The Reroll button deals new cards. Clicking needs the addon (/vpk).
draft.vpk_on: [Draft] Clickable cards are on. They need the Ability Brawl addon; if the cards are blank, type /vpk again.
draft.vpk_off: [Draft] Clickable cards are off, pick with a digit in chat.
draft.vpk_found: [Draft] Ability Brawl addon found: draft cards can be clicked. /vpk off switches it off.
draft.imbue_needs_addon: [Draft] Ability-targeted items need the Ability Brawl addon.
draft.vpk_missing: [Draft] The Ability Brawl addon did not load in your game, so clickable cards would be blank. Check that the VPK is in game/citadel/addons and that gameinfo.gi has its line (see clientside/README.md).
draft.tab_needs_addon: [Draft] A click in the TAB view upgrades drafted abilities only with the Ability Brawl addon. Without it, upgrade with ALT + ability key.
draft.tab_addon_missing: [Draft] A click in the TAB view needs the Ability Brawl addon, and it did not load in your game: check that the VPK is in game/citadel/addons and that gameinfo.gi has its line (see clientside/README.md). Meanwhile upgrade with ALT + ability key.
menu.title: ABILITY {0}/{1}
announce.reloading: Reloading the map, your kit is kept
vote.chat_rules: [Draft] Rules: type 1 for Standard, 2 for Street Brawl (or /vote standard, /vote brawl)
vote.chat_format: [Draft] Format: 3 - Draft, 4 - Chaos (random heroes and abilities), 5 - Shuffle (an ability changes after each use)
vote.too_many: [Draft] Too many players for Street Brawl ({0}, at most {1}) - playing Standard.
vote.no_chaos: [Draft] Not enough heroes or abilities for Chaos - drafting instead.
vote.footer: Click a tile or type its digit in chat. A tie goes to the lobby leader's vote.
format.shuffle_hint: an ability changes after each use
match.over: [Draft] The match is over. In {0} s the lobby reopens and only the lobby leader stays.
panel.lobby_hint: Hold TAB to use the mouse. /draft and /preset still work.
stats.page: [Draft] The full table: AbilityDraft.stats.html next to the plugin on the server.
